title: GhostWatch
body:
# 👻 GhostWatch PRO

The Ultimate Administration & Player Verification SuiteGhostWatch PRO is an all-in-one professional moderation tool designed for Minecraft servers.
It combines stealth investigation, advanced player verification (checking for cheats), and a custom punishment system with a beautiful, multilingual interface.

🌟 Key Features

🛡️ Advanced Player Checking: Teleport suspects to a designated area, freeze them, and display custom titles on their screen.

👻 Ghost Mode: Spectate players invisibly with a single command. Your inventory and location are safely restored afterwards.

🚫 Custom Ban System (GBan): Replace the clunky vanilla bans with a high-end ban screen featuring live countdowns, reasons, and admin signatures.

🔐 Security PIN: Protect staff accounts! Administrators must enter a 4-digit PIN to move or execute commands.

🌍 Full Multilanguage Support: Switch the entire plugin (messages, titles, menus) between English and Polish via a single config line.

⚡ Zero-Lag & Lightweight: Optimized code with a built-in reload system for instant configuration updates.

💻 Commands & Permissions
```
/watch <player>                             permission: ghostwatch.use
/sprawdz <player>                           permission: ghostwatch.use
/czysty <player>                            permission: ghostwatch.use
/gban <player> <days> <reason>              permission: ghostwatch.ban
/gub <player                                permission: ghostwatch.ban
/pinset <4 digits>                          permission: ghostwatch.use
/sprsetSet                                  permission: ghostwatch.admin
/greloadReload                              permission: ghostwatch.admin
/ginfoDisplay                               permission: ghostwatch.use
```
⚙️ ConfigurationThe plugin is highly customizable. You can edit:Messages: Every single string is translatable.Ban Screen: Create a unique look for banned players using multiple lines and colors.Titles: Configure the duration and text of on-screen alerts during verification.Escape Penalties: Automatically ban players who log out during an active check.

🛠️ InstallationPlace the GhostWatch.jar in your plugins folder.Restart your server.Set the language in config.yml (PL or EN).Set your check-room location using 
/sprset.
Enjoy a safer, cheat-free server environment!
